label: Private credit (interval fund + non-traded BDC)

cliffwater_cclfx.membership_rationale: Direct corporate lending in a Rule 23c-3 interval wrapper, the cohort's reference member. Daily NAV, quarterly obligated liquidity.

bcred.membership_rationale: Direct-lending private credit in a non-traded BDC chassis: the same strategy as cclfx on different plumbing (150% asset-coverage leverage, discretionary quarterly tenders, monthly NAV). Admitted deliberately cross-wrapper so the caveat machinery has real work.

pflex.membership_rationale: Flexible multi-sector credit in the SAME wrapper as cclfx (interval, quarterly 5%). A wrapper twin with a broader credit mandate (loans, structured, EM). Mandate breadth is the disclosed mismatch.

cion_ares.membership_rationale: Diversified credit in the cclfx/pflex wrapper (interval, quarterly 5%). Joins via the census promotion pipeline. The dual-adviser CION+Ares structure and a leverage-inclusive Managed Assets fee base (1.89% of net assets at FY2025 leverage) widen the cohort's fee-base axis. Daily Class I NAV (CADUX).

ocic.membership_rationale: Perpetual non-traded BDC running quarterly 13e-4 tenders, bcred's closest structural twin. Admitted via the census promotion pipeline (46 SC TO-I filings as T1 cadence evidence, Owl Rock -> Blue Owl rename verified in the SEC record).

caveats: LEVERAGE-REGIME MIX: BDC 150% coverage and non-1940-Act wrappers allow materially more leverage than 1940-Act funds. Fee bases and return volatility are not like-for-like. [typed per product: bcred: BDC 150% asset-coverage regime, cion_ares: 1940-Act asset-coverage limits, cliffwater_cclfx: 1940-Act asset-coverage limits, ocic: BDC 150% asset-coverage regime, pflex: 1940-Act asset-coverage limits]

LIQUIDITY-LAW MIX: Rule 23c-3 obligations, discretionary tenders, and repurchase plans give different worst-case exit rights. Cadence numbers alone overstate comparability. [by wrapper type: bcred: board-discretionary share repurchases, cion_ares: Rule 23c-3 OBLIGATION (board cannot skip a window), cliffwater_cclfx: Rule 23c-3 OBLIGATION (board cannot skip a window), ocic: board-discretionary share repurchases, pflex: Rule 23c-3 OBLIGATION (board cannot skip a window)]

NAV-CADENCE MIX: daily, monthly, and quarterly NAV processes embed different appraisal smoothing. Volatility and drawdown comparisons inherit that difference (see de-smoothing lab). [typed per product: bcred: monthly, cion_ares: daily, cliffwater_cclfx: daily, ocic: quarterly, pflex: daily]
